ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer (1.7 port) + IsoRim
ModMetaData.description: Unofficial port of Multiplayer to RimWorld 1.7. Requires RimWorld 1.7 and Harmony. Doesn't need Prepatcher. Place this mod right below Core and expansions in the mod list.\n Multiplayer mod for RimWorld, ported to RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10). This isn't an official release of the RimWorld Multiplayer Team: report problems with this port to its fork, not to the official mod. Fork: https://github.com/ladelisandwich/Rimworld-Multiplayer (branch port-1.7) Official mod (RimWorld 1.6): https://github.com/rwmt/Multiplayer Includes IsoRim Waylith, an isometric 3D view (https://github.com/peren717/IsoRim-1.7), a RimWorld 1.7 port by Lin (peren717) of IsoRim by Connor (kndzio, https://github.com/kndzio/IsoRim). MIT licence, full text in IsoRim/LICENSE. Turn the 3D view on and off with 0; settings are under Options, Mod settings, IsoRim. The 3D view is per player: each player chooses their own view and settings. Turn off the standalone IsoRim mod, it is built in here. A slow 3D frame rate on one player's PC slows the game for everyone in a session.
